purpose: WP2r high-SNR implementation functional check; descriptive diagnostic only, not a held-out performance estimate

data.split_policy: new diagnostics-only engineering role; no TRAIN, DEV, TEST, calibration, evaluation, or confirmation files are read
data.parent_unit: physical parent; 32 independent parents per each of three jammer types
data.parent_id_rule: seed*1000000 + [0,31]; audit all registered data receipts recursively, including sweeps, equal-PFA, and confirmation roles; fail on any overlap

metrics.SJR_improvement: paper2.evaluation_1103_v4.radar_metrics sjrif_db, parent-wise then averaged within jammer type
metrics.E_U: paper2.evaluation_1103_v4.group_metrics u_nmse, parent-wise then averaged within jammer type
metrics.GMM_pure_noise: for one preregistered parent/type/pulse y00=epsilon, record input energy, reconstructed output energy, change energy, and E0=||output-input||^2/||input||^2

uncertainty: report per-parent values and descriptive means; no inferential claim or bootstrap decision
failure_policy: stop on dataset identity, nonfinite output, shape, or parent overlap failure; do not silently drop scenarios
revision: run 1 seed 2026112707 collided with registered sweep cell_07 parent IDs and was invalid; rerun with seed 2026112801 and recursive receipt audit; output moved to a seed-specific subdirectory because the previous fixed path contains the superseded colliding-seed dataset and must be preserved
